en.askTitle: Put in your own jobs, salary and start date to get a first-rental plan with real ads and costs
en.runTitle: Moving to Amsterdam for work in April 2027: a couple’s first rental on about EUR 2,200 a month

fields.label: Workplaces
fields.value: Amsterdam (the couple is moving there for work)

fields.label: Each person’s gross salary and holiday-pay treatment
Employment start and probation terms
fields.value: Starting 1 April 2027; one partner has a Dutch highly-skilled-migrant permit

fields.label: Moving cash
fields.placeholder: e.g. EUR 8,000 for deposit and moving costs

fields.label: Commute and furnishing needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. under 40 minutes to work by train, unfurnished is fine

en.template: Plan our first rental near {workplaces} for {arrival}, with {salary}, {employment}, {ceiling}, {cash} and {commute}. Compare the full bills, income filters and registration for both adults; flag WWS, permit and tax questions and a temporary-stay fallback. Plan only; do not contact, apply, reserve or pay.

phases.title: Check the official rental, registration and 2027 tax rules
phases.note: Rent limits, deposit and agency-fee rules, address registration and the 2027 expat tax allowance
phases.judgment: It caught that the “30% ruling” is not 30% for this couple: the tax office’s 4 November 2026 newsletter says a new starter on 1 April 2027 gets a maximum of 27%, and EUR 95,000 of combined income cannot show eligibility, since the salary test applies to one person.

phases.title: Collect and check live listings across five areas
phases.note: More official tenant rules, and the first listing searches

phases.title: Write the guide and the source list, and check them
phases.judgment: A separate colleague who had not written the guide re-ran the take-home pay maths on its own, getting EUR 5,042.62, 6,317.01 and 6,197.90 a month as in the guide, and confirmed that the budget adds up to EUR 3,925 and that the short stays and unconfirmed registration are disclosed.

phases.title: Fill the listing gaps and confirm 12 current ads across four areas
phases.judgment: It would not stretch the count to five areas: no 2-room apartment in Zaandam could be confirmed, so the guide counts four areas, marks two ads as short stays, and says the 12 ads are a snapshot, not twelve homes confirmed for April.

workers: Checked what the tax office currently publishes about the 2027 expat tax allowance, the salary conditions and how to apply, and worked out take-home pay examples
Found current individual rental ads in Haarlem, Zaandam and Diemen with rent, size, furnishing and the date each was seen
Read the official Dutch rental rules: the points system and rent limits, deposit, agency fees, and address registration
Reviewed the finished guide and source list on its own, re-ran the take-home pay maths and compared the listing details with the saved pages
